content_blocks.text: The rain pounded against the tin roof, each drop echoing through the empty house. SARAH, a young woman with wild, untamed hair, sat by the fireplace, her fingers tracing the intricate patterns on the old map spread before her. The map was her lifeline, a guide to the mysterious island where her father had disappeared years ago. She closed her eyes, letting the sound of the storm wash over her as she whispered, 'Father, if you’re out there, please send me a signal.'
